SILT#00003: For those of you using Tauri Store plugin, the store file gets loaded (<https://tauri.app/reference/javascript/store/#load>) from the app data directory (<https://tauri.app/reference/javascript/api/namespacepath/#appdatadir>). Remember, if there is good documentation for your tools, read through it carefully, as it can save you development time
